name: yeremi/cli-standards
description: PHPCS standards for CLI command design, currently focused on WP-CLI code, with blocking and advisory sniffs for safety, automation, output, and documentation.

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the sniff unit tests and the ruleset end-to-end checks.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run each sniff over the shared fixtures and compare reports per line (PHPUnit).
scripts-descriptions.test:fixtures: Run the ruleset end-to-end checks (CLIStandards, CLIStandardsMust, custom rulesets, phpcbf).
scripts-descriptions.test:fixtures:verbose: Run the ruleset end-to-end checks with per-case details.
scripts-descriptions.test:update: Regenerate the per-line expectations of the sniff unit tests (review the diff).
scripts-descriptions.test:docs: Check that every sniff has a doc and docs/sniffs.md is up to date.
scripts-descriptions.docs: Regenerate docs/sniffs.md from the sniff docs.
